_readme: Hand-picked deals. The deploy workflow merges these with live Awin vouchers into deals.json every day. Fields: id, title, store, url, categories (pregnancy, health, nursery, travel, hospital, newborn, feeding, sleep, play, safety), markets (country codes like GB, US, DE, or EU / ALL), benefit (REAL discount text — required for affiliate links), code, expires (YYYY-MM-DD), affiliateUrl (network tracking link). Generic store links per country are built into the app, so only add real offers here.
